benchmark: No Samoa-specific benchmark in COVERAGE.md; none of the NZ benchmark places is in this region. Negative benchmarks respected: village wrappers (Falealupo, Fagamalo, Safune) and a minor memorial (Sapapaliʻi) rejected; the Ohakune-style bar applied by source count.
note: Score is Wikipedia views only; kept spots rank by Wikivoyage/LP naming (6 of 9 have 0 views because their pages do not exist), so every candidate with views is nominally stronger; each is left out for a concrete What-qualifies reason (Wikipedia-only, no visitor source, village/wrapper, or sent to review).
